description: A browser LEAF's CapabilityAnnouncement, generated by `net-mesh-leaf`'s own encoder (Stage 5) from the deterministic identity below, and pinned here so the core's production `CapabilityAnnouncement::from_bytes` / `to_bytes` / `verify` assert the same bytes from the other direction. This fixture exists because `CapabilityAnnouncement` lives in the core crate and a wasm leaf cannot link it, so Stage 5 carries a deliberate second WRITER of this one document (its verifier is codec-free). A drift on either side reddens the other side's suite. Note the shape a leaf produces: tags sorted with the two mandatory role tags `leaf` and `transport:rtc`, `noise_pubkey` present (the plan's §5 Layer 1 key-discovery datum), and reflex_addr / rtc_addr / rtc_bootstrap / hop_count / allowed_* / owner_cert all absent because a browser sets none of them.

identity.note: Deterministic test keys. Ed25519 secret = 32 x 0x21, X25519 secret = 32 x 0x22.
